# Boston Dental Centre

> A comprehensive NHS and private dental practice in Boston, Lincolnshire offering general dentistry, cosmetic treatments, and specialist services with CQC accreditation.

Boston Dental Centre serves the Boston community with both NHS and private dental care options. The practice features modern equipment including iTero digital scanners and Belmont dental chairs, staffed by GDC-registered dentists including Dr Leyla Amini and Dr Mansourhe Tavasoli.

## Key Topics

- NHS dentistry
- Private dentistry
- Dental implants
- Invisalign
- Orthodontics
- Dental treatments
- Patient care
- Dental fees
- Payment plans
- CQC accreditation
- iTero Digital Scanner
- Emergency care
- Periodontal care
- Dental referrals
- Patient reviews
